name: io.github.apinoahq/apinoa-mcp
title: apinoa
description: Products, social posts, search results and AI answers from Amazon, TikTok, Google, ChatGPT and more.

environmentVariables.name: APINOA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your apinoa API key (create one at https://apinoa.com/en/dashboard/api-keys).

environmentVariables.name: APINOA_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: code (default): one sandboxed TypeScript tool over the whole API. tools: one tool per kind of read.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer <your apinoa API key>. Without it, the client signs in with OAuth and gets a key of its own.
